items.title: PHP紧急修复两项严重漏洞，官方敦促用户立即升级  现在，此时此刻 PHP 团队发布安全更新，修复两项可能让攻击者无需登录即可远程执行代码的严重漏洞。
items.title_zh: PHP 紧急发布补丁，修复两项严重远程代码执行漏洞
items.title_en: PHP Releases Emergency Patches for Two Critical RCE Flaws
items.summary: PHP released emergency security updates (8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35) fixing two CVSS 9.2 unauthenticated remote code execution flaws affecting PHP-FPM, mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, and LiteSpeed deployments.

items.title: 🍏 苹果将于周三发布首款触屏 MacBook Pro
items.title_zh: 苹果将于周三发布首款触屏 MacBook Pro
items.title_en: Apple to unveil first touchscreen MacBook Pro on Wednesday
items.summary: Apple is expected to unveil its first touchscreen MacBook Pro on Wednesday, adding OLED and Dynamic Island in 14- and 16-inch models at a higher price.
